resources.string: Auto-check travel times when you connect to Android Auto
Required for travel time lookups. Get one from the Google Cloud Console with Directions API enabled.
A build-time API key is present and used if this field is left blank.
No build-time API key found — enter one here.
Tap the map to select a location
A route is DELAY when extra traffic minutes are this value or more (delay ≥ threshold). Default is %d. ON TIME / DELAY labels are always shown; color is extra.

Leave this off unless Android Auto connection is not detected in the car. When on, a USB plug-in waits a few seconds, then runs a check at most once every 10 minutes so a charger does not fire every time.
Allow location all the time so a check can run when Android Auto connects, even if this screen is closed.
Commute Checker reads your location in the background only when Android Auto or car mode connects. It finds the nearest saved Place and runs matching watches. It is not used for tracking.

Commute Checker reads your location in the background when Android Auto connects, or when USB power is detected (the last-resort option you enabled). It finds the nearest saved Place and runs matching watches. It is not used for tracking.
Setup complete. You can test a check from the home screen.
Enter an API key to continue.
Home is used to detect where you are when the car starts. Pick it on the map, by address, or with GPS coordinates.
Add the place you want travel time to — Work, Truckee, or anywhere you drive.
Could not find that address. Try a different spelling or GPS coordinates.
A watch named “To %1$s” will run every day from %2$s (a window that includes the current time). You can edit days and season later under Commute Watches.
